text:
jordan (PM): quick sync — we need a rollout plan for the new feature-gating behavior that allows per-customer overrides + an emergency kill path. thinking: staged regions, A/B for metric validation, and a dual-write telemetry mode. TL;DR: safe, observable, killable.

sasha (product): +1. we should define launch criteria before picking percentages. what are the must-watch metrics?

devin (eng): p50/p95 latency, token cost delta, and error rate (5xx + model-fallback rate). also consistency: mismatch rate between old and new routing for same prompt (we can sample).

anya (sre): add backend CPU/GPU queue depth, queue time, and region saturation. if any region shows >85% GPU utilisation for 5m, auto-decrease traffic.

jordan (PM): proposed launch criteria (draft):
- customer overrides validated in staging
- p95 latency delta < 15% vs baseline
- end-to-end error rate increase < 0.1
- mismatch rate sample < 2% (for functional regression)
- telemetry dual-write verified (no loss)

mike (ops): for emergency kill path we need: global flag that flips within 5s, per-region kill switch, and per-customer immediate override. ops playbook for paging.

sasha (product): A/B plan suggestion: 1) shadow for 24h 2) 1% live traffic for 6h 3) 5% for 24h 4) 20% for 48h then ramp if green. each step: validate metrics and qualitative evals from a small prompt set.

devin (eng): technical notes: customer overrides are implemented as a priority list in routing: runtime checks `customer_override -> tenant_flag -> global_flag -> default`. overrides should be stored in a fast KV with TTL and an audit log.

anya (sre): how about a soft-kill first? route customer to old path but keep telemetry so we can compare. full kill only if metrics cross thresholds. reduces blast radius.

jordan (PM): good call. soft-kill (shadow-failover) as the first fallback. then hard-kill if persistent. add to runbook.

mike (ops): permission model: only SRE + oncall lead can hit global hard-kill. product and SEs can request soft-kill per-customer via ticket but we need auto-approval for security incidents.

sasha (product): on telemetry dual-write: we will write events to both `routing_v1` and `routing_v2` so we can compute delta. ensure event ids are stable for dedupe. telemetry-bot, can we get a feasibility check?

telemetry-bot: dual-write baseline latency overhead estimated ~2-4ms/event, storage delta ~10GB/day for 1% traffic. sampling can reduce this.

jordan (PM): decision: dual-write ON for shadow + 1% cohorts. sample 10% of messages for full payloads, rest minimal metrics.

devin (eng): config snippet for flag-based rollout (pseudo):
```
feature_gate: "customer_routing_v2"
rules:
  - condition: customer in startup_cohort
    treatment: v2
    percent: 100
  - condition: default
    treatment: v1
kill_paths:
  - name: soft_kill
    action: shadow_to_v1
  - name: hard_kill
    action: route_to_v1
    ttl: 3600
```

anya (sre): add autoscaling policy mapping to rollout: small ramps (1% -> 5% -> 20%) must include node autoscaling triggers so we don't saturate. tie each step to a pre-check lambda that confirms GPUs free.

mike (ops): also add cross-region fallback: if region A latency/p95 spikes > 30% for 10m AND error increase >0.2, route affected slices to region B with warm-up pool.

sasha (product): what about A/B for quality? we should run a small human-eval with targeted tenants at 5% step to catch content regressions. set up quick feedback channel with some customer champions.

jordan (PM): launch checklist (action items):
- [dev] implement priority override KV + audit log (devin)
- [sre] add autoscale pre-check hook per ramp (anya)
- [ops] define kill permissions + runbook (mike)
- [telemetry] dual-write + sampling plan (telemetry team)
- [product] recruit 3 customer champions for initial 5% test (sasha)
- [pm] finalize gating thresholds and ship docs (jordan)

devin (eng): timeline? I can deliver KV + basic routing in 2 sprints if we keep scope minimal. dual-write plumbing might need infra help.

anya (sre): from SRE side, need a week to add pre-check hooks and alerting dashboards. will stub dashboards for the shadow phase earlier.

jordan (PM): proposed timeline: shadow (week 1), 1% (week 2), 5% (week 3), 20% (week 4) — contingent on metrics. we can stretch if infra needs more time.

sasha (product): one more thing — add a telemetry check for model-match drift: if model outputs for same prompt differ semantically > threshold, pause ramp. define threshold before go.

mike (ops): logging: make sure every override flip is auditable and emits `override_event` with actor, reason, and request_id. ops-bot should pick this up and add to incident timeline automatically.

ops-bot: configured: will post `override_event` to #incidents with tags for actor and request_id.

jordan (PM): ok team — I'll draft the rollout doc and PR the runbook. please add comments in the doc by EOD. If no major objections, we'll lock the plan tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

sasha (product): sounds good. tagging @customer-success for champion outreach next.

devin (eng): adding one last note — test harness for mismatch sampling: we should include both raw tokens and normalized outputs to compute simple diffs. saves time on false positives.

anya (sre): agreed. i'll add dashboards for mismatch rate and resource impact.

jordan (PM): thanks everyone. saving this thread into the rollout doc.

mike (ops): :rotating_light: reminder — emergency paging drill scheduled next Wed. make sure runbook is ready by then.

sasha (product): noted.

jordan (PM): end of thread — will follow up with PR link shortly.
